notes: Stop names are the engraved names; the Voice Palette alternatives (in brackets in the manual) are not listed separately. MIDI GT/SW/PED A and B couplers are not included.
The Pedal Bourdon Doux 16 is borrowed from the Swell.

MIDI master channels Great 12, Swell 13, Pedal 14 are taken from the Rodgers 690 manual (same Rodgers/Roland generation); this model's own manual pages found online only list the MIDI-coupler channels (1-3, 5-7). Check on your organ.

Stops are sent as Rodgers/Roland System Exclusive bit-map messages with a checksum (one message covers a group of stops). Cecilia cannot match these to single stops yet - a future Rodgers bit-field driver is needed - so every stop is unbound. Use Learn every stop only if your organ also sends a simple message per stop; otherwise only the notes are recorded.

When the organ receives MIDI Start it sends a snapshot of all stop and expression settings (documented for the 690). Receiving Program Change 20 on the Great master channel selects the General Canceler (690 manual); not used as all_stops_off because the 0/1-based numbering is not stated.
Expression: on the 690 the shoes send MIDI volume (CC 7) on the master channels; not verified for this model, so no expression mapping is set.
Stop list: https://www.manualslib.com/manual/929905/Rodgers-Trillium-T807.html?page=57 (Rodgers Trillium T807 owner's manual, "Stop Specification", printed p. 48)

MIDI scheme: https://www.manualslib.com/manual/902957/Rodgers-690.html?page=42 (Rodgers 690 owner's manual, "MIDI Features" pp. 42-43 and MIDI Implementation Chart p. 44 (dated 4/12/93), ManualsLib viewer pages: Great master channel 12, Swell 13, Pedal 14; expression sent as MIDI volume on the master channels; stop changes and memory dumps by System Exclusive; received Start sends the current stop and expression status)
